name: Attorneys by county in Ohio, California, Michigan, Idaho, Arizona, Washington and Pennsylvania, from each bar's public counts
description: How many lawyers each bar counts in each county, for seven states. Ohio: attorneys by county of address and status, from the Supreme Court of Ohio's attorney directory list (88 counties, with admission decade, private practice and Spanish speakers). California: active, inactive, judge and not-eligible licensees in each of the 58 counties, from the State Bar's county table. Michigan: active State Bar members living in each of the 83 counties, with private practice and the change from 2024. Idaho: members by status in each of the seven judicial districts. Arizona: active State Bar members in each of the 15 counties (the Bar's 2022 report). Washington: WSBA licensees of every type (lawyers plus limited licensees) in each of the 39 counties, with the attorney counts by member type. Pennsylvania: active attorneys in the seven counties the Disciplinary Board's annual report lists, and the Board's statewide status counts. Each record carries the source's own as-of date and a rate per 10,000 residents from the Census Bureau's county estimate. Only counts are published, and where a count is built from a directory file no name, birthdate, address or registration number is kept or written. In Ohio, counts in a disciplinary, deceased or other status, an admission decade, private practice or Spanish are published from five lawyers up, and only where no smaller count in the same group can be worked out from a county's total or the statewide figures. Every state record ties to its source's own total, and every published number is read a second time from the source file before release.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Attorneys by county in Ohio, California, Michigan, Idaho, Arizona, Washington and Pennsylvania, from each bar's public counts (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23962861

distribution.name: attorneys.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: attorneys.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: attorneys-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in attorneys-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to attorneys.csv on id.

recordSet.name: attorneys
recordSet.description: The records of Attorneys by county in Ohio, California, Michigan, Idaho, Arizona, Washington and Pennsylvania, from each bar's public counts, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter code of the state whose bar published the count: OH, CA, MI, ID, AZ, WA or PA

field.name: level
field.description: county; district (Idaho judicial district); county-not-given (members in the state's total whom the source's county rows do not place, derived); out-of-state (members with an address outside the state, as the source defines it); state (the source's statewide figures)

field.name: countyName
field.description: County name as the Census Bureau writes it; for other levels a plain label

field.name: value
field.description: The record's main count; the unit says what it counts

field.name: unit
field.description: What the value counts (for example active attorneys with an address in the county)

field.name: total
field.description: Everyone the source counts in the group, any status

field.name: year
field.description: Year of the source's as-of date

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: asOf
field.description: The source's as-of date: a day, a month or a year (California's page shows none, so it is the day it was read)

field.name: basis
field.description: What the source counts, in a sentence

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
